text:
Anya: Heads-up: we need to rework Q2 RICE bucket. Prospect X just asked for data residency (EU-only), SLO 99.95, and audit certification. They want a timeline before committing. Thoughts? @Marta @Liam
Marta: Big upside if they sign, but effort looks large (VPC, cert, region ops). Impact high but effort could blow a quarter. :grimacing:
Liam: Could we unbundle into: A) Residency + audit for PoC (minimal), B) full managed EU tenancy afterward? Staging reduces upfront effort.
Devon: Agree on staging. Important tradeoff: doing residency now increases infra ops and duplicates some of the Dedicated work. If we delay, we keep momentum on batching/Optimize which saves $$ long term.
Priya: From GTM: prospect is strategic — could open three similar accounts. Estimated ARR ~220k. That feels like it should shift prioritization beyond raw RICE.
Anya: Let's outline two RICE entries: 1) "PoC residency + audit slice" 2) "Full EU single-tenant onboarding". Also consider a "strategic multiplier" for deals >$200k ARR.
Marta: I'll propose numbers for the PoC slice: Reach=3 (pilot seats), Impact=7, Confidence=0.5, Effort=4. Anyone want to run the RICE calc?
Liam: (3*7*0.5)/4 = 2.625. Low compared to platform perf projects.
Devon: Example: Batching/Optimize (cache & quantization) Reach=120, Impact=2, Conf=0.75, Effort=12 => (120*2*0.75)/12 = 15. So optimize looks better purely by RICE.
Priya: That's expected. But if Prospect X converts, we get strategic access. Suggest adding a qualitative flag "Sales-qualified" and auto-route those >$200k to Exec review instead of raw multiplier.
product-bot: quick poll created: "Escalate Prospect X PoC (residency+audit) over Optimize work?" Options: Escalate / Keep Optimize priority / Need more info. Link: https://redwood.internal/polls/5123
Anya: Minimal PoC acceptance criteria draft: 
```
- Data residency: EU-only processing and storage
- SLO: 99.95% for API availability in EU region (PoC SLA window)
- Audit: baseline access logs + signed Data Processing Addendum
- Key management: host-managed keys for PoC, BYOK for full-prod
- Deployment: tenant routing + region pinning, no full VPC onboarding
- Rollout: canary 2% -> 20% -> 100% with auto-rollback
```
Marta: If we scope like that, effort drops because we avoid full VPC and BYOK complexity. Dev/deploy complexity still nontrivial but doable in 6-8 weeks.
Liam: I'll map dependencies: infra (region infra + routing), security (DPA + audit format), infra-engineering for canary hooks, ops runbook. I'll attach a GANTT sketch.
Devon: I'll run cost delta + perf tail impact vs investing those cycles in Optimize. Need numbers by Thu so we can feed the RICE sheet.
Priya: I'll confirm the prospect timeline and whether they can accept a staged BYOK swap later. If they insist on BYOK for PoC, that raises effort a lot.
Anya: Decision rule proposal: keep numerical RICE as-is but add a "commercial escalation" bucket for any opportunity >$200k ARR. Escalation triggers exec review and possible re-prioritization. Simple and transparent.
Marta: Works for me. We should also document why numeric RICE may under-index strategic capture (notes field on sheet).
product-bot: poll results so far: 3 Escalate, 2 Keep Optimize priority, 1 Need more info. Poll link: https://redwood.internal/polls/5123/results
Anya: Action items: Marta update PoC acceptance criteria doc, Liam dependency sketch and timeline, Devon cost/perf comparison, Priya confirm sales timeline and BYOK requirement. Reconvene Friday 10am to finalize whether to escalate.
Liam: Adding link to live RICE tracker: https://docs.redwood/intern/rice/q2-2026 (update rows under "Commercial Escalations")
Anya: Thanks all. We'll keep Optimize queued but not blocked; if exec picks escalation we'll timebox the PoC.
Marta: I'll draft the exec note summarizing ARR, strategic value, and recommended trade-offs if poll holds.
product-bot: reminder set for Fri 10am sync.
Anya: End of thread.
